entities.summary:
Alees Thomas Samaan is a Bahraini politician and former ambassador to the United Kingdom.

She was born in the year 1964 to a Bahraini family and received her education from the University of Bahrain.

In 1997, Samaan began her career in diplomacy, joining the Bahraini Ministry of Foreign Affairs. She served as the Bahraini ambassador to the United Kingdom from 2007 to 2011.

In 2005, Samaan became the first woman to chair the Bahraini upper house of parliament, the Consultative Council. She was a member of the council until 2010.

Samaan was a key figure in Bahrain's efforts to strengthen its ties with the international community.

She played a significant role in promoting Bahrain's economic and cultural relations with the United Kingdom.

Samaan is the first Bahraini woman to hold the position of chair of the Consultative Council.

She was appointed as the chair of the Bahraini delegation to the Gulf Cooperation Council in 2010.

Samaan has received several awards for her contributions to Bahraini politics and diplomacy.

She was appointed as the chair of the Bahraini delegation to the Arab League in 2015.
